item.text: I’ve finished the implementation and verification locally. I’m waiting on an independent review pass to catch any requirement mismatch I might have missed.

Created the Rust 2021 project under [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml:1), with module-backed library code in [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs:1), [src/sorted_set.rs](/output/src/sorted_set.rs:1), and [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs:1), plus the standalone entry file [test6.rs](/output/test6.rs:1). The implementation preserves the C++ behavior: default `n = 6`, only `argv[1]` is used, `atoi`-style permissive parsing, set union semantics, and matching output formatting including the trailing space on the last line.

Compiled successfully with `rustc --edition=2021 /output/test6.rs -o /output/test6` and `cargo build --release`. I also ran `cargo test`, and compared `/output/test6` byte-for-byte against `/workspace/dataset/test6_executable` for no args, `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `10`, `-3`, `abc`, `12xyz`, `+5`, and extra args; all matched.
